scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @kurdbook/api" "npm run dev -w @kurdbook/web" "npm run dev -w @kurdbook/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kurdbook/api && npm run build -w @kurdbook/web && npm run build -w @kurdbook/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kurdbook/api && npm run typecheck -w @kurdbook/web && npm run typecheck -w @kurdbook/admin
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
